prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a striking modern close-up fashion portrait of a clearly adult woman from a side angle against a bright blue sky. Give her short wavy light-gray hair partially covering the forehead, fair skin, sharp features, straight neat dark eyebrows, naturally pink lips, and a calm but intense expression. She wears a black bandana with white swirl patterns, a black zip-up jacket worn open over a black T-shirt with fictional green-and-red graphic art, a thin silver chain, and a small silver earring. Use front light at approximately 5600K with soft white bounce to highlight her facial features and outfit. Focus on expression, silver hair strands, bandana texture, zipper, chain, and natural skin detail. Keep the portrait edgy, stylish, modern, non-sexual, and free of real logos or celebrity likeness.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, sexual pose, fetish framing, ambiguous age, provocative styling, real logo, celebrity likeness, watermark, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, extra fingers, deformed face, distorted bandana, illegible shirt graphic
